status_summary: No DOE action since 2025 on the Mandate's leadership recommendation for the Office of Intelligence and Counterintelligence was found. A CRS report of 2024-06-07 describes the office's director as reporting directly to the Secretary under existing statute and appointed by the Secretary with Director of National Intelligence concurrence. A DOE biography page published 2026-02-27 shows the office led by an acting director who joined it in 2004, served as its principal deputy director from 2024 to 2026, and has military intelligence experience.
title: Lead DOE intelligence office with an appointee with intelligence experience
uncertainties: Absence of evidence from a limited search. The researcher searched everycrsreport.com, energy.gov and ran a general web query on the director; the reviewer re-read the energy.gov biography page. The page does not state the start date of the acting role or whether the post holder is a career or political appointee, and no nomination or designation of a political appointee was found. Intelligence authorization provisions were not checked.
